purpose: Make the single 500-model workflow the evidence-driven refresh point for repository inventory, capabilities, benchmarks, learning, quality, performance, safety, and public observability without treating inventory presence as proof of functionality.
mastery_rule: Only passing evidence satisfying the applicable benchmark gates may close a gap. External-model-assisted results cannot establish native Buddy mastery.
preservation_rule: Canonical capabilities and existing data are preserved. Missing or disconnected components are recorded as gaps rather than silently removed or rewritten.
public_projection_rule: Every public-safe tracked domain should have a Pages projection or an explicit reason/status explaining why it is unavailable. Secrets, credentials, private data, and privileged controls never enter public projections.
cost_rule: No paid model/API call is initiated implicitly by inventory or verification. Providers requiring paid access remain blocked until explicitly configured and approved.
notification_rule: Surface meaningful regressions, newly fixed blockers, newly closed gaps, stale evidence, and owner-action blockers; suppress routine success noise.
